input.prompt: A 240-litre wheeled plastic wheelie bin of the kind lined up in city back alleys: a tall, slightly tapered, dark green moulded plastic body with a flared top rim, a flat hinged lid, closed, with a thick handle bar across the back at the hinge, two solid black wheels on an axle at the bottom of the back, shallow vertical ribs moulded into the front. Slightly scuffed and dusty. Plain plastic: no markings, no numbers, no stickers, no lettering. Product photo for 3D reconstruction: exactly one object, shown whole and centred with a generous empty margin on every side, nothing cropped. Three-quarter front view from slightly above (camera about 20 degrees above the horizon and about 35 degrees off the front axis), a long lens with little perspective distortion. Isolated on a plain, seamless, uniform pure white background. Soft, even, diffuse studio lighting from all around: no harsh highlights, no cast shadow or contact shadow, no floor, no reflections of surroundings. No other objects, no people, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no badges, no watermark. Photorealistic, sharp, accurate real-world proportions and materials.
